description: Behavioral probes for metadata, geometry, preset classification, thermal commands, parser semantics, settings normalization, volume assignment, painted fuzzy skin and purge-tower rounding. Includes indexed configuration and chamber-temperature pipeline probes. Includes purge-budget assignment probes. Includes intersecting-solid surfaces, Sweep/Loft Boolean volume contracts and legacy text alignment. Includes the reviewed d226 followups and ModelArrange contracts. Includes CIEDE2000 reference and area-weighted painted-anchor probes. Includes public DRC import, multi-region ironing parameter isolation, and SLA wall-thickness contracts. Includes source-preserving external presets, saved inheritance and detach behavior, and support-dependent SLA pad contracts, and small-overhang support removal.
